Class Dealership

java.lang.Object
Dealership
public class Dealership extends Object
Manages the inventory, reporting, and file I/O operations of the car dealership. Maintains vehicles in a sorted TreeSet according to pricing and tie-breaker criteria.

    • loadVehiclesFromFile

      public boolean loadVehiclesFromFile(String filename)
      Reads and parses vehicle records from a delimited text file into the inventory TreeSet. Expected format:
      • VEHICLE#Brand Model#basePrice#age#km#fuelType
      • ELECTRIC#Brand Model#basePrice#age#km#fuelType#batteryCapacity#hasHeatPump
      Falls back to predefined hardcoded instances if the file cannot be read or parsed.
      Parameters:
      filename - Path to the file (e.g., "vehicles.txt")
      Returns:
      true if loaded successfully from file, false if fallback was used

    • loadPredefinedInstances

      public void loadPredefinedInstances()

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      Main application entry point. Loads inventory, generates analytical report, logs operations to console and 'cardealerApp.log', and writes output to 'outputDealership.txt'.
      Parameters:
      args - Command line arguments (not used)
